title: Hearty Russian Stew
description: A plant-based take on the classic Russian stew, packed with nutritious vegetables and energizing flavors.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the beef broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Stir in the tomato paste and dried thyme.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with energizing spice blend to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Enjoy your hearty and satisfying Russian stew!
